title: Understanding Bootstrapping
text: Bootstrapping is a statistical method that involves resampling with replacement from a dataset to estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic. It is often used to estimate confidence intervals.

title: Data Requirements for Bootstrapping
text: To perform bootstrapping, you need a sample that is representative of the population. The sample should be large enough to capture the variability in the data.

title: Population vs. Sample Data
text: The original dataset for $$2018$$ does not include trip duration, which is necessary for calculating the mean trip duration. Without this information in the population data, bootstrapping may not provide reliable estimates.
